title: Text capability — failure codes
pins: WHICH failure a given misuse produces, identified by a stable code. Error prose is explicitly outside the contract: it is worded idiomatically per language, and pinning it would hold every implementation to a translation and go red on a wording improvement that changed nothing.

php.gap: particle-academy/prism carries no error codes at all — PrismException identifies its failures by an English sentence and nothing else. The reference runner therefore reaches its verdict by MATCHING ON PROSE, in a suite whose entire argument is that prose is not the contract. That shim lives in runners/php/src/Driver.php and is marked as one. See finding F-1, which is the highest-value change this work suggests for the PHP package.
php.cause_note: particle-academy/prism carries NO ERROR CODES AT ALL -- PrismException identifies its failures by an English sentence. Both ports have codes. The reference is behind its own ports here.
